title: The Telling the Team the Knot Was Wrong
youtube_title: The Telling the Team the Knot Was Wrong | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Esme feels shy about a knot that was wrong and needed a calm correction. Instead of pretending not to care, Esme tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
